environmentVariables.description: Hostname or IP of your HomeMatic CCU (debmatic, CCU3, or OpenCCU/RaspberryMatic)
environmentVariables.name: CCU_HOST

environmentVariables.description: CCU admin password (same as the WebUI login). Must be set; the value may be empty for a CCU with no password
environmentVariables.name: CCU_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: CCU username
environmentVariables.name: CCU_USER

environmentVariables.description: Connect to the CCU via HTTPS (self-signed certificates supported)
environmentVariables.name: CCU_HTTPS

environmentVariables.description: CCU API port (80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS)
environmentVariables.name: CCU_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Directory for the device type cache and session persistence
environmentVariables.name: CACHE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist of browser origins. Unset = no cross-origin browser access (default-deny). An allowlisted origin is reflected exactly in Access-Control-Allow-Origin (never '*'); the list also drives DNS-rebinding origin checks
environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS

environmentVariables.description: Extra Host header values accepted by DNS-rebinding protection (comma-separated host:port); add your hostname when behind a proxy or container DNS name
environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated names of multiple CCU targets (e.g. 'prod,dev'). Each profile takes the flat CCU_* settings prefixed CCU_<NAME>_ (CCU_PROD_HOST, ...), plus policy flags CCU_<NAME>_PROTECTED (writes need confirm:true) and CCU_<NAME>_READONLY. Unset = single default profile from the flat CCU_* vars
environmentVariables.name: CCU_PROFILES

environmentVariables.description: Which profile from CCU_PROFILES is active at startup (default: the first listed)
environmentVariables.name: CCU_DEFAULT_PROFILE

environmentVariables.description: Verify the CCU's TLS certificate against the system trust store. Only meaningful with CCU_HTTPS=true. Default false, because a CCU ships a self-signed certificate — prefer CCU_TLS_FINGERPRINT or CCU_CA_CERT to verify one of those
environmentVariables.name: CCU_TLS_VERIFY

environmentVariables.description: Pin the CCU's self-signed leaf certificate by its SHA-256 fingerprint (hex, colons optional). The strongest option for an appliance: the connection is rejected unless the presented certificate matches. Takes precedence over CCU_CA_CERT
environmentVariables.name: CCU_TLS_FINGERPRINT

environmentVariables.description: Path to a PEM file holding the CCU's CA or self-signed certificate. The connection is then validated against it with standard chain verification
environmentVariables.name: CCU_CA_CERT

environmentVariables.description: Timeout for a CCU JSON-RPC call, in MILLISECONDS
environmentVariables.name: CCU_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: Timeout for HomeMatic Script execution (ReGa), in MILLISECONDS — scripts are slower than plain API calls
environmentVariables.name: CCU_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: Lifetime of the on-disk device-type schema cache, in SECONDS
environmentVariables.name: CACHE_TTL

environmentVariables.description: Token-bucket burst size for CCU requests — how many may be issued back to back
environmentVariables.name: CCU_RATE_LIMIT_BURST

environmentVariables.description: Sustained CCU request rate, in requests per second
environmentVariables.name: CCU_RATE_LIMIT_RATE

environmentVariables.description: How often MCP resources are polled for change notifications, in SECONDS
environmentVariables.name: RESOURCE_POLL_INTERVAL

environmentVariables.description: error | warn | info | debug. Logs are structured JSON on stderr
environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL

server.name: io.github.cmendezs/mcp-nfe-br
server.description: MCP server for Brazilian e-invoicing: NF-e and NFC-e (modelo 55/65), schema 4.00, SEFAZ.

environmentVariables.description: Master switch. Set to '1' to disable all write-side tools across NF-e, NFC-e, NFS-e, AND CT-e (br__submit_nfe, br__distribute_dfe, br__submit_nfse, br__cancel_nfse, br__submit_cte, br__cancel_cte, br__correct_cte). Read-only mode for safe exploration. Setting only this variable is sufficient to disable all CT-e writes too — BR_CTE_READ_ONLY is an additional, independent gate, not a required second step.
environmentVariables.name: BR_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to disable the three CT-e write-side tools (br__submit_cte, br__cancel_cte, br__correct_cte). Independent of BR_READ_ONLY — either variable being set to '1' is sufficient to block CT-e writes; use this one to gate CT-e alone while leaving NF-e/NFS-e writes enabled.
environmentVariables.name: BR_CTE_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Logging level: DEBUG, INFO (default), WARNING, or ERROR
environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
